title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 360 (Powers and functions of Official Liquidator)

content.overview: The Official Liquidator shall exercise such powers and perform such duties as the Central Government may prescribe. Without prejudice to the generality of that power, the Official Liquidator may exercise all or any of the powers specified in section 290 and such other powers as may be prescribed, and shall perform such duties as the Central Government may prescribe for the purposes of winding up of companies by the Tribunal.
content.glance: Official Liquidator exercises powers and performs duties as prescribed by the Central Government, including powers under s. 290 and other prescribed powers.
